name: Agent instructions
title: Agent instructions: what every agent Rouh starts is told before anything else, the rules with their Agent switch on

jobs: every run of the one program and every crew worker starts with them (one/runs.py _instructions, rouh/crew.py)
touches.remove: Delete rouh/agent_instructions.py and rouh/web/agent_instructions.py, this manifest, the agent_instructions tool in rouh/tools.py, fetch_instructions and its caller in one/agents.py and one/runs.py, and the instructions argument of CrewManager in rouh/crew.py and rouh/runtime.py; take the Agent switch off the Rules page (rules.SIDES, set_switch, for_every_agent, and run_block's leaving out what every agent is told) and drop the four agent_instruction tables with a migration. Agents then start with no standing instructions but a run's brief. Since 30 October 2026 the instructions themselves are rules in the owner's Synapse Master, on the Rules page with Agent on, and stay there.
